posts.title: Power Rankings Recap: Week 1
posts.excerpt: John Bregger holds the #1 spot after Week 1 with a Power Score of 49. Plus a new season record.
posts.body:
Week 1 is in the books, and the Power Rankings have been recomputed from this season's real results — record, points scored, all-play breakdown, coaching efficiency, and optimal-lineup breakdown, all rolled into one Power Score.

## This Week's Power Rankings

- **1. John Bregger** — 49 pts
- **2. Michael Farris** — 42 pts
- **3. Jonathan Avery** — 40 pts
- **4. Will Hadley** — 35 pts
- **5. Shep Shepherd** — 33 pts
- **6. Brandon Baxter** — 28 pts
- **6. jacob reedy** — 28 pts
- **8. Nick Yacovazzi** — 18 pts
- **9. Daniel Foster** — 13 pts
- **10. Jeff McCormick** — 9 pts

## Milestones

- **New season-high single week score:** John Bregger with 166.2.
- **New season-low single week score:** Jeff McCormick with 75.7.
- **New biggest blowout of the season:** jacob reedy over Jeff McCormick by 51.3.
- **New closest win of the season:** Will Hadley over Brandon Baxter by just 0.1.

## By the Numbers, Week 1

- **John Bregger** put up the week's high score: 166.2.
- **Jeff McCormick** had the week's low score: 75.7.
- **jacob reedy** posted the week's biggest margin of victory, beating **Jeff McCormick** by 51.3.
- **Will Hadley** survived the week's closest game, edging **Brandon Baxter** by just 0.1.
